::: callout
## Learning Objectives
- Consider coverage issues that come with different sampling frames in practice
- Understand sources of observation error
- Implement revisions to questions following the 10 guidelines for question writing.
:::

For additional details, read Chapters 3 & 4 of  [**Internet, Phone, Mail, and Mixed‐Mode Surveys: The Tailored Design Method**](https://csu-calpoly.primo.exlibrisgroup.com/discovery/fulldisplay?docid=alma991067612891702901&context=L&vid=01CALS_PSU:01CALS_PSU&lang=en&search_scope=Everything&adaptor=Local%20Search%20Engine&tab=Everything&query=any,contains,Internet,%20Phone,%20Mail,%20and%20Mixed%E2%80%90Mode%20Surveys:%20The%20Tailored%20Design%20Method%5C&offset=0) (2014) by Don A Dillman, Jolene D Smyth, and Leah Melani Christian

  - Available for free online through the library
  - I would **highly recommend** going through this reading -- the slides are a summary of these chapters.
